scope: Only the existing current-only suffix proven to have zero historical context, including its qualified first-MTP case. No new length, dataset, or request-content routing.
attention: Original BF16 Q/K/V, unchanged native causal FIA/scale; no Q/K/V rotation or inverse rotation in the exact single-source attention computation.
query_validation: Retain the existing copy_validate_bf16_query_out finite/slot check using disjoint preallocated raw-query scratch.
cache_write: Unchanged per-head BF16 key centering, BF16 K/V rotation, original INT2 quantizer/clip and rotated exact snapshots. Same original K/V and same PT must produce bit-identical writer inputs and cache bytes.
history_and_mixed: Unchanged rotated FP32 partials and FP32 merge before one inverse rotation. Cached history is never reconstructed or bypassed.
native_single_key: Output is the original BF16 V exactly for every GQA query head.

operation_change.output_copy: Keep the original-size copy into contiguous preallocated storage; native FIA validates shape/dtype but not output contiguity.

model_quality_gate: Ten runs per side, top-three means, each of accuracy/accuracy_easy/accuracy_hard/accuracy_short within one percentage point; source/functional checks are not model scores. Top-three ranking convention must be explicit.
performance_gate: Preserve both already accepted32K and64K performance workloads; no length boundary or changed launch parameters.
